offer.speaker: tatsumi
offer.text: Before I send you on missions, you need to control your chakra, not just have it.

offer.speaker: tatsumi
offer.text: Gather it. Feel it. Then stand still and let it settle. (G for Chakra Control, then hold Sneak to focus.)

steps.text: Hold Sneak and stand still to focus your chakra

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: Good. Now keep that chakra in the soles of your feet, and walk straight up the cliff north of here.

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: Too little and you slip. Too much and you're blasted off. Steady. Last one to the top makes dinner.

steps.bar: Catch your breath at the top
steps.text: Walk up the cliff north of the training ground

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: Not bad. Ren's still halfway up, and Yui made it first. Ren makes dinner.

dialogue.speaker: yui
dialogue.text: It's all about balance. You did well too!
